subject: Zoning Code Recodification
overview: The board reviewed and finalized its recommendations for the city's comprehensive zoning code recodification. Following discussions on performance standards, housing definitions, accessory dwelling units, and planned development districts, the board voted to forward its recommendations to the City Council.

items.title: Reopening of Hearing and Performance Standards
items.summary: The board reopened the public hearing to review proposed performance standards in the zoning recodification, focusing on operating hours and noise regulation references.

items.title: Video Signage Regulation
items.summary: The board discussed video sign regulations with the Chamber of Commerce, agreeing to forward sample regulatory language directly to the City Council.

items.title: Traffic Management Standards
items.summary: The board reviewed traffic performance standards and agreed to let the city transportation planner refine technical requirements regarding traffic study thresholds and multimodal mitigation.

items.title: Family Definition and Housing Code Enforcement
items.summary: Building Commissioner Paul Mochi and Attorney Bobrowski discussed replacing the zoning definition of family with the U.S. Census definition of household to avoid legal issues while addressing overcrowding through health and safety codes.

items.title: Aesthetic Standards, Fiscal Analysis, and Accessory Dwelling Units
items.summary: The board simplified fiscal analysis requirements for applicants and recommended placing Accessory Dwelling Unit special permit authority with the board alongside a 30-day minimum rental occupancy requirement.

items.title: Planned Development District Provisions
items.summary: Attorney Bobrowski outlined proposed Planned Development District regulations designed to give the city flexibility to negotiate customized zoning and community benefits with developers.

items.title: Linkage Ordinance Discussion
items.summary: The board discussed the city's current linkage ordinance and planned a dedicated future briefing with staff to explore potential updates.

items.title: Community Development Board Rules and Associate Members
items.summary: The board reviewed administrative rules, confirming term limits, design review roles, and mayoral appointment of up to two associate board members.

items.title: Site Plan Review, Dover Amendment, and Definitions
items.summary: The board reviewed decision timelines for site plan review, Dover Amendment procedural standards, and updated definitions for open storage, retail store sizes, and half-stories.

items.title: Final Vote on Zoning Recodification Recommendations
items.summary: The board voted to approve the full package of zoning recodification recommendations and authorized the chair to finalize text details with city staff before submission to the City Council.
